cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a service in use checks people against the ID: SIM rules have operators record the NINA, and the justice platforms and payroll take the number or the card.
cells.note: Decree 2023-0679 of November 2023 orders every civil servant's data matched against the biometric RAVEC records, so a use is under way. SIM registration records the NINA rather than checking it against the register, so not 3.
